description: FNAS-LCD: train one searched architecture on an uploaded dataset, on SDSC Expanse. Submitted by the FNAS-LCD service with each user's own login.

appArgs.name: mode
appArgs.description: src/training/expanse_job.py's train mode. The service adds the dataset, the architecture and the training settings; anything else is refused.

containerArgs.name: start-folder
containerArgs.description: Start in /app, so the image's entrypoint.sh runs.

containerArgs.name: gpu
containerArgs.description: Make the node's GPU usable in the container.

containerArgs.name: datasets
containerArgs.description: Every uploaded dataset, read-only, as /datasets/<upload job id>/dataset.

schedulerOptions.name: allocation
schedulerOptions.description: The Expanse allocation ICICLE's services charge their jobs to.

schedulerOptions.name: singularity-cache
schedulerOptions.description: Keep converted images in the shared cache in harvest's scratch space.
